The Defender Wolf Series II Tactical and Utility Vehicles, a next‑generation military mobility platform developed by Defender and JLR. Designed and engineered in the United Kingdom, the vehicle is intended for military operations requiring exceptional off‑road capability, durability and mobility across challenging terrain. Based on Defender's purpose‑engineered D7x architecture and monocoque construction, the Defender Wolf Series II Tactical Vehicle represents the latest evolution of the Defender Wolf military vehicle lineage, supporting personnel transport and operational missions in demanding environments.

Defender Wolf Series II is a next‑generation military vehicle developed by Defender and JLR. Engineered in the UK and based on Defender’s durable D7x body architecture, the vehicle is designed for defence applications requiring high levels of mobility, capability and resilience. The Defender Wolf Series II represents the latest evolution of the Defender Wolf lineage, combining proven off‑road performance with modern engineering and military‑focused functionality.
